name: haproxy_high_http_5xx_error_rate_backend_v1
title: HAProxy high HTTP 5xx error rate backend (v1)
description: Too many HTTP requests with status 5xx (> 5%) on backend

source.upstream_alert: HAProxy high HTTP 5xx error rate backend (v1)
source.upstream_query: sum by (backend) (rate(haproxy_server_http_responses_total{code="5xx"}[1m])) / sum by (backend) (rate(haproxy_server_http_responses_total[1m])) * 100 > 5 and sum by (backend) (rate(haproxy_server_http_responses_total[1m])) > 0
source.upstream_description: Too many HTTP requests with status 5xx (> 5%) on backend {{ $labels.backend }}
source.query_normalized: The upstream threshold could not be lifted out of the expression (its outermost operator is and/or/unless, or it compares against another series), so the expression is normalised to 1 per matching series and the alert fires on any match. The observed value in the notification is therefore always 1.

query_condition.promql: (sum by (backend) (rate(haproxy_server_http_responses_total{code="5xx"}[1m])) / sum by (backend) (rate(haproxy_server_http_responses_total[1m])) * 100 > 5 and sum by (backend) (rate(haproxy_server_http_responses_total[1m])) > 0) * 0 + 1
